name: Z image Turbo / Futuristic Superbikes
description: Continuing with my LoRa tests in Z Image Turbo, I've retrieved old datasets from some of my SD 1.5 LoRas to speed things up and be able to do several training sessions in a row without wasting time. If you like motorcycles, you'll love this LoRa. I literally just spent four hours testing it because it was so much fun and brought back so many good memories of the SD1 era that I almost didn't post it today xD. Try it out and give me feedback. The more detail and creativity you include, the better futuristic motorcycles you'll create. I hope to receive all your love and that you post your craziest dream motorcycle concepts digitally on this wall!! Devildonia
